description:
FILED s431 (Opus 5), minimised from the module-population census (#462).

    local $_ = \*STDOUT; print $_ "x\n";        perl x     PCL DROP
    my $fh = \*STDOUT;   print $fh "x\n";       perl x     PCL x     (right)
    my $fh = \*STDOUT;   print $fh "x\n" for (1);  perl x  PCL x     (right)

So the `for` modifier is NOT the trigger (it was the shape in the source, which
is why it looked like one): the trigger is `$_` in the FILEHANDLE slot.  PPI
tokenises `$_` as `PPI::Token::Magic`, not `Symbol`, and the scalar-filehandle
detector in the print family evidently tests for a Symbol -- the sibling-shape
question of CLAUDE.md rule 11 (`_is_print_term_start` and its neighbours already
form this family; find the one predicate).

WHERE IT BITES: cpan-tests/modules/Test-Simple-1.302199/t/lib/Test/Builder/NoOutput.pm
lines 118 and 125 (`print $_ @_ for @$self;` / `printf $_ @_ for @$self;`), silent
today.

BAR: the three rows above + `printf $_ ...`, `print {$_} ...` (the block form,
which must keep working), and a REAL magic use in the same slot (`print $0 ...`
is a filehandle named by a string variable -- probe what perl does before
widening); corpus-diff; gate-SET scan if a detector widens; a Pl/t guard row.


DONE s441b (Opus agent B; merged by Fable s440 as c003571). PPI::Token::Magic IS a subclass of PPI::Token::Symbol, and all three of PCL's filehandle-slot tests were exact-class `ref($t) eq 'PPI::Token::Symbol'` -- so no filehandle was extracted and the leftover `$_ "x\n"` run had two terms with no operator between them. perl's rule is `indirob: WORD | scalar | block` where `scalar` is ANY scalar variable (probed: `$_`, `$,`, `${^NAME}` all write to the handle they hold; `$0="STDOUT"; print $0 "x"` goes through the symbolic handle). ONE predicate Pl::PExpr::_is_scalar_fh_token (isa + `$`-sigil guard; `$#a` is a Token::ArrayIndex, so it stays out by construction) at all three sites: the operator-loop print path, the `print $fh -e $f` filetest repair, the paren form. _is_print_term_start -- the other half of the decision -- untouched. Measured vs caa3d07: corpus-diff IDENTICAL, lib A/B SAME=22, perl-t A/B SAME=528, cpan A/B 402 with t/lib/Test/Builder/NoOutput.pm the ONLY DIFF; RCDIFF=0. Census 81/185 -> 80/183. Guard Pl/t/print-fh-magic-01.t (11 rows -- 3 write to a real FILE, 4 negatives, 2 emission-shape); inverse-run with the old exact-class test = 14 failures. A DETECTOR WIDENS, so a gate-SET scan is owed on the merged batch (Fable). NOT fixed, FILED: #512 `$0` is not writable in PCL at all; #513 `open($fh,'>&',...)` dup fails in every spelling.
